user.title: RAE Electricity Price
user.description: Track an electricity tariff from the RAE registry (energycost.gr). Enter the provider and plan exactly as shown on the registry. For the plan, omit any trailing month-version such as "06.26" (type "My Home Online", not "My Home Online 06.26") so it keeps working when the provider bumps that version.

data_description.provider_filter: Exactly as listed on the RAE registry, e.g. ΔΕΗ.
data_description.plan_filter: Exactly as listed, WITHOUT the trailing month-version. e.g. My Home Online (not My Home Online 06.26).
data_description.discounted_price: Use the discounted price (with conditions) instead of the standard price.
data_description.url: Leave empty to use the default public data feed.
